mLocKeys.keySummary: Master Yi teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed, dealing physical damage to multiple units in his path, while simultaneously becoming untargetable. Alpha Strike can critically strike and deals bonus physical damage to monsters. Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Master Yi becomes Untargetable and teleports to rapidly strike enemies near his target, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage to all enemies hit after @AlphaStrikeBounces@ hits.

This Ability can strike the same enemy repeatedly if there are no other targets, dealing @SubsequentHitMultiplier*100@% damage for subsequent hits (@SubesquentDamage@), for a maximum single target total of @SingleTotalDamage@ physical damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Applies %i:OnHit% On-Hit effects at @BaseOnHitMultiplier*100@% damage. Subsequent hits are reduced to @SubsequentHitMultiplier*100@% of this.
Can critically strike for an additional @CritBonus@ physical damage. Subsequent hits are reduced to @SubsequentHitMultiplier*100@% of this, for a maximum single target total of @SingleCritTotalDamage@.
Jungle monsters take @BonusMonsterDamage@ bonus damage per strike.
Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @BasicAttackCDR@ second.
{{ Spell_AlphaStrike_Name }} does not reduce its own cooldown or stack {{ Passive_MasterYiPassive_Name }} %i:OnHit% On-Hit.
Master Yi will reappear near the initial target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipSimple:
Become untargetable and teleport to the targeted enemy, dealing damage to it and enemies nearby.

Basic attacks reduce the cooldown of Alpha Strike.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Alpha Strike</titleLeft><mainText>This unit will take physical damage soon.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Alpha Striking</titleLeft><mainText>Master Yi is striking multiple units for physical damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Highlander</titleLeft><mainText>Master Yi's Move Speed and Attack Speed are increased and he cannot be slowed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Master Yi moves with unparalleled agility, temporarily increasing his Move Speed and Attack Speed as well as making him immune to all slowing effects. While active, Champion kills or assists extend Highlander's duration. Passively reduces cooldown for his other abilities on a kill or assist.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Champion takedowns reduce the remaining Cooldown of Master Yi's basic Abilities by @RCooldownRefund*100@%.

Active: Master Yi enters a trance, gaining @RMSBonus@% Move Speed, @RASBonus@% Attack Speed, and immunity to Slows for @RDuration@ seconds. Champion takedowns extend the duration of this Ability by @RKillAssistExtension@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>The duration of <spellName>{{ Spell_Highlander_Name }}</spellName> is paused during <spellName>{{ Spell_AlphaStrike_Name }}</spellName> and <spellName>{{ Spell_Meditate_Name }}</spellName></rules>
mLocKeys.keyTooltipSimple:
Passive: Champion takedowns reduce the Cooldown of Master Yi's basic abilities.

Active: Grants Move Speed, Attack Speed, and immunity to slows for @RDuration@ seconds.

While active, champion takedowns extend the duration of Highlander by @RKillAssistExtension@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Double Strike</titleLeft><mainText>Master Yi's next attack will be a Double Strike.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Double Strike</titleLeft><mainText>Master Yi's next attack will be a Double Strike.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Double Strike</titleLeft><mainText>Every 4th attack, Master Yi will double strike.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
Every few consecutive basic attack, Master Yi strikes twice.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Every few consecutive basic attack, Master Yi strikes twice.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Every @AttackCount@th Attack, Master Yi strikes twice. The second Attack deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Passive_MasterYiPassive_Tooltip}}

The second strike counts as a normal Attack; it is able to critically strike and applies on-hit effects.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Meditating</titleLeft><mainText>Master Yi is recovering his Health, reducing incoming damage, charging Double Strike and pausing the duration of Wuju Style and Highlander.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Master Yi rejuvenates his body by focus of mind, restoring Health and taking reduced damage for a short time. In addition, Master Yi will gain stacks of Double Strike and pause the remaining duration on Wuju Style and Highlander for each second he channels.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Master Yi channels, restoring @TotalHeal@ Health over @HealDuration@ seconds. This healing is increased by up to @MaxMissingHealthPercent*100@% based on Master Yi's missing Health.

While channeling and for @DRLinger@ seconds afterwards, he takes @InitialDR@ reduced damage, decreased to @DamageReduction*100@% after the first @InitialExtraDRDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Master Yi will gain stacks of Double Strike.
Damage reduction is halved against turrets.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipSimple:
Channel to reduce incoming damage and restore health over @HealDuration@ seconds.

Attempting to move or attack will end the channel.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Grants bonus true damage on basic attacks.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Master Yi's Attacks deal an additional <trueDamage>@TotalDamage@ true damage</trueDamage> for @Duration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>The duration of <spellName>{{ Spell_WujuStyle_Name }}</spellName> is paused during <spellName>{{ Spell_AlphaStrike_Name }}</spellName> and <spellName>{{ Spell_Meditate_Name }}</spellName></rules>
mLocKeys.keyTooltipSimple: Basic attacks deal bonus damage for @Duration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Wuju Style Activated</titleLeft><mainText>Master Yi has activated Wuju Style to deal bonus true damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
